determine the cause: Experts are still working hard to determine the cause of the fire that destroyed the old market.
專家們仍在努力查明燒毀舊市場那場火災的原因。
determine the outcome: The last three minutes will determine the outcome of the basketball game, so the players must stay focused.
最後三分鐘將決定這場籃球賽的結果，所以球員必須保持專注。
be determined to win: After losing last year, our team seems to be determined to win the championship this time.
去年輸了之後，我們隊這次似乎決心要贏得冠軍。
determine one's fate: Some people believe the stars determine their fate, but I think our own choices matter more.
有些人相信星象決定他們的命運，但我認為我們自己的選擇更重要。
devise a plan: The students met after school to devise a plan for raising money for the animal shelter.
學生們放學後聚在一起，想出為動物收容所募款的計畫。
devise a method: The scientist spent years trying to devise a method for turning sea water into drinking water cheaply.
那位科學家花了好幾年，試圖設計一種便宜地把海水變成飲用水的方法。
devise a solution: The city must devise a solution to the traffic problem before the new stadium opens next year.
市政府必須在新體育館明年啟用前，想出解決交通問題之道。
devote time to: If you devote time to practicing English every day, your speaking will improve quickly.
如果你每天投入時間練習英文，你的口說會進步得很快。
devote oneself to: After retiring, my aunt decided to devote herself to helping poor children learn to read.
退休後，我阿姨決定獻身於幫助貧困兒童學習閱讀。
a devoted fan: As a devoted fan of the singer, Amy has gone to every one of her concerts since 2018.
身為那位歌手的死忠粉絲，艾咪從2018年起參加了她的每一場演唱會。
devote a chapter to: The author chose to devote a chapter to her childhood in a small fishing village.
作者選擇以一整章來討論她在小漁村的童年。
diagnose the problem: The mechanic needed an hour to diagnose the problem, and it turned out to be a broken wire.
技師花了一小時診斷問題，結果原來是一條電線斷了。
be diagnosed with: My uncle was diagnosed with high blood pressure by his doctor, so he now eats less salt.
我叔叔被醫生診斷出有高血壓，所以他現在少吃鹽。
diagnose a fault: The computer program can diagnose a fault in the engine and show a warning on the screen.
這個電腦程式能找出引擎的故障，並在螢幕上顯示警告。
dictate terms: Because it was the only supplier, the company could dictate terms to all the small shops.
因為是唯一的供應商，這家公司可以向所有小商店訂定條件。
dictate the pace: The fastest runner tried to dictate the pace of the race from the very beginning.
跑最快的選手從一開始就試圖主導比賽的節奏。
be dictated by the market: The price of eggs is dictated by the market, so it can go up quickly when supply is low.
雞蛋的價格由市場決定，所以在供應不足時可能迅速上漲。
dictate a letter: The busy boss would often dictate a letter to his secretary while walking around the office.
忙碌的老闆常一邊在辦公室走動，一邊向秘書口述信件。
differ in opinion: My parents often differ in opinion about where to travel, but they always find a way to agree.
我父母常對去哪裡旅行意見不同，但他們總能找到共識。
differ from: Twins may look alike, but their personalities can differ from each other in many ways.
雙胞胎也許長得很像，但他們的個性在許多方面可能彼此不同。
agree to differ: We argued about the movie for an hour, and in the end we decided to agree to differ.
我們為了那部電影爭論了一個小時，最後決定各自保留意見。
opinions differ: Opinions differ on whether students should be allowed to use phones in class.
對於是否應允許學生在課堂上使用手機，看法分歧。
digest the news: It took her a few days to digest the news that her best friend was moving to another country.
她花了好幾天才消化最好的朋友要搬到另一個國家這個消息。
digest information: Taking short notes during the lecture helps students digest information more easily.
在課堂上簡短做筆記有助於學生更輕鬆地消化資訊。
digest food: Our stomach needs a few hours to digest food, so it is better not to swim right after lunch.
我們的胃需要幾個小時消化食物，所以最好不要午餐後立刻游泳。
hard to digest: The news that the factory would close was hard to digest for workers who had been there for thirty years.
對已在那裡工作三十年的員工來說，工廠要關閉的消息令人難以接受。
dim the lights: Please dim the lights before the movie starts so everyone can see the screen clearly.
電影開始前請調暗燈光，讓大家都能清楚看到螢幕。
memories dim: As the years pass, memories dim, so I keep a diary to remember the special moments of my life.
隨著歲月流逝，記憶會變得模糊，所以我寫日記來記住人生中的特別時刻。
take a dim view of: Most teachers take a dim view of students copying homework from the Internet.
大多數老師不看好學生從網路上抄作業的行為。
